text.title: Go Project Structure Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) + valid/invalid examples + forbidden patterns for go-project-structure output.

section.title: Schema

example.note: module_path empty; binaries empty; internal_packages misuses pkg/ at top level; vertical_slices missing; loose files and cycles above the hard maximum of 0.

list.item: main.go containing business logic instead of only flag parsing, config load and wiring
an internal-only package placed under pkg/ instead of internal/
a cyclic import between internal subpackages
a loose .go file or a scratch directory at the module root
a repeatable workflow living in an ad-hoc shell script instead of a Make target
missing required fields, or values outside the declared numeric / enum / pattern bounds
Sort cmd binaries alphabetically in the spec.
